{{Citation}}
'''Gravity compensators''', also known as '''gravity field compensators''', were fitted to [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] and passageways aboard [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in order to help transitions through differing [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] orientations. When turbolifts transitioned between two areas with differing gravity orientations, the lift rotated to match the destination's orientation. The compensators ensured that the lift occupants did not notice the transition at all. [[DoubleSec Corp]] manufactured gravity field compensators for starships, including the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], and the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] featured gravity compensators in its central passage tube.
